title: Bridge v5.1 gaps: migrate routing to task_type+launch_mode, add session_id/req_code, solo role-commit, GUI updates, migration tooling

context.baseline_assumption: Current codebase still routes by executor_type × session_mode and lacks v5.1 migration/tooling.
context.target_state: Codebase implements v5.1 task schema + routing, launch_mode selection/lock, unified session_id + req_code, solo role-commit workflow, and GUI support.

in_scope: Introduce v5.1 task schema fields: task_type, launch_mode, launch_mode_locked
Deprecate routing dependence on executor_type and session_mode (backward-compat allowed via migration layer)
Implement Launch Mode selection logic (CCB/Bridge) including lock behavior
Implement unified session_id generation and REQ CODE derivation for CCB
Implement RDLOOP_REQ boundary markers in CCB output handling
Implement solo mode constraints: per-role isolation + role switch requires git role-commit + knowledge injection hook point
Add v5.1 migration tooling and schema file
Update GUI Task Editor to support task_type + launch_mode + launch_mode_locked and remove reliance on deprecated fields
out_of_scope: Refactoring OpenClaw upstream code or adding new OpenClaw commands beyond what rdloop needs
Implementing a full knowledge-agent retrieval service (only add hook points + interface contract)
Rewriting tmux/pane infrastructure beyond necessary changes for v5.1 semantics

deliverables.description: JSON Schema for v5.1 task.json including task_type, launch_mode, launch_mode_locked, deprecation notes for executor_type/session_mode
Migration script converting v5.0/v5.0.2 style tasks to v5.1 fields deterministically; idempotent
Deterministic session_id generator per task+role+attempt (format per v5.1)
REQ code derivation from session_id for CCB channel; stable mapping
Coordinator routing migrated to task_type + launch_mode (+ lock), with backward-compat via migration layer
Add role-commit subcommand; used by solo role switch protocol
Agent-side operational rules required by v5.1
GUI supports task_type + launch_mode + launch_mode_locked; server exposes needed endpoints
Golden/contract tests for schema, migration, routing, session/req, and GUI serialization

functional.description: Coordinator must route tasks by task_type ∈ {copywriting, solo, multi_agent} and launch_mode ∈ {ccb, bridge} per v5.1
acceptance: Given a v5.1 task.json with task_type=solo and launch_mode=ccb, run_task.sh chooses solo execution flow and uses CCB channel
Given launch_mode_locked=false, GUI/run path prompts user to pick launch_mode at runtime; choice persists into the run record
Given launch_mode_locked=true, no prompt occurs and the configured launch_mode is enforced

functional.description: Backward compatibility: v5.0 tasks with executor_type/session_mode must still run via migration layer
acceptance: migrate_task_json_v51.sh converts v5.0 task to v5.1 fields deterministically (no random values except timestamped IDs where specified)
Converted file validates against task_schema_v51.json
run_task.sh can consume either legacy or v5.1 task.json, but internal routing uses v5.1 fields only

functional.description: Unified session_id and REQ CODE boundary markers for CCB
acceptance: session_id_gen.sh generates IDs in the v5.1 format T01-<role>-<NN>-<timestampOrAttempt> (exact format documented + tested)
req_code_gen.sh maps session_id -> req_code deterministically (documented + tested)
CCB output includes [RDLOOP_REQ:<req_code>:START] and [RDLOOP_REQ:<req_code>:END] boundaries and coordinator can extract the segment between them

functional.description: Solo mode role-switch protocol with role-commit
acceptance: git_ops.sh role-commit exists and creates a commit with standardized message template including role, session_id, and attempt id
In solo flow, before switching role, coordinator calls role-commit and persists evidence pointers for the next role
A hook point exists for 'knowledge injection' (can be a no-op implementation) and is invoked on role switch with structured input

functional.description: GUI supports v5.1 fields and no longer depends on deprecated fields
acceptance: TaskEditor shows Task Type dropdown (copywriting/solo/multi_agent)
TaskEditor shows Launch Mode dropdown (ccb/bridge) + launch_mode_locked checkbox
Saving a task produces v5.1 task.json (task_type/launch_mode/launch_mode_locked present)
Legacy fields (executor_type/session_mode) are not required for saving; if present, GUI flags them as deprecated (non-blocking)
All generated IDs (session_id/req_code) are reproducible given documented inputs
All migrations are idempotent (running twice yields identical output)
Coordinator writes an event log entry for: migration applied, launch_mode chosen, session_id assigned, req_code assigned, role-commit done

non_functional.description: Minimal surface area change and safe rollout
acceptance: Default behavior for existing tasks remains unchanged unless migrated or explicitly set
A feature flag (env or config) can force legacy routing OFF after migration (for future cleanup), but default keeps compat ON

must: Do not break existing v5.0 task execution paths; route internally via v5.1 after migration
Add tests for every new script and every routing branch
No silent fallback: if task_type/launch_mode missing after migration, fail with explicit error and remediation hint
All new scripts must be executable (chmod +x) and shellcheck-clean where applicable
should: Keep changes localized: coordinator + tools + gui; avoid broad refactors
Prefer pure bash for tools to match existing conventions
Prefer contract tests (golden fixtures) for migration and routing

forbidden: Do not introduce new external runtime dependencies (python/node packages) just for migration/tooling
Do not remove executor_type/session_mode fields from legacy tasks in-place unless writing a migrated copy or explicit overwrite flag is set
Do not implement 'knowledge agent' as a networked service in this task (hook only)

phases.name: Inventory + fixtures
tasks: Add fixtures for legacy v5.0 tasks and expected migrated v5.1 outputs
Add baseline routing tests that characterize current behavior (golden) to prevent regressions

phases.name: Session ID + REQ CODE tooling
tasks: Add tests for boundary parsing and edge cases

phases.name: Coordinator routing migration
tasks: Update run_task.sh to normalize task.json to v5.1 in-memory before routing
Implement task_type routing branches and map to existing execution engines

phases.name: Solo role-commit protocol
tasks: Insert role-switch checkpoints in solo flow (role-commit + knowledge hook + next pane)
Add tests verifying role-commit and event logging

phases.name: GUI updates
tasks: Update TaskEditor.jsx to support v5.1 fields
Add server endpoints if needed (e.g., runtime prompt persistence)

phases.name: Regression + docs
tasks: Add Agent rules docs: solo_pane.md and launch_mode.md
Run full regression suite and produce test_report.txt

acceptance_tests.name: Schema validation
steps: Validate all v5.1 tasks against Rdloop/docs/schema/task_schema_v51.json
pass_criteria: All fixtures validate; invalid fixtures fail with expected errors

acceptance_tests.name: Migration idempotency
steps: Run migrate_task_json_v51.sh twice on the same legacy fixture
pass_criteria: Second output is byte-identical to first output

acceptance_tests.name: Routing correctness
steps: Run coordinator in dry-run mode (or test harness) for each combination of task_type and launch_mode
Ensure internal routing selects the correct execution path
pass_criteria: Logs/events show task_type-based path and launch_mode-based channel selection

acceptance_tests.name: REQ boundary extraction
steps: Simulate CCB output containing RDLOOP_REQ START/END markers with noise around it
pass_criteria: Extracted payload matches expected and parser handles missing END/START with explicit error

acceptance_tests.name: Solo role-commit workflow
steps: Simulate solo run with two roles (coder -> judge) in harness
pass_criteria: A commit exists with required metadata; event log contains ROLE_COMMIT and KNOWLEDGE_INJECT hook call

acceptance_tests.name: GUI v5.1 task save/load
steps: Open TaskEditor, create task with task_type+launch_mode+locked, save
Reload task and verify fields persist
pass_criteria: Saved JSON contains v5.1 fields; GUI renders them correctly on reload

required_files: out/events.log (or equivalent) showing key v5.1 events
nice_to_have: Screenshots of GUI TaskEditor showing new controls

legacy_to_v51.executor_type/session_mode: Mapped to task_type and launch_mode via deterministic mapping table documented in migrate_task_json_v51.sh; ambiguous cases must fail loudly with remediation hints
legacy_to_v51.channel_type/run_surface: Mapped to launch_mode when possible; otherwise requires explicit override

future_cleanup: After this task lands and passes regression, plan a follow-up to remove deprecated fields and code paths behind a flag
